title: jun-ui Static Artifact Example
description: A file-openable dashboard produced through the static artifact lane.

sections.title: When to use
sections.body: Use the static lane when data is known at build time or can be bundled into the artifact.
items: Local tools that do not need server writes.
Review artifacts that must move as a folder.

sections.title: What jun-ui owns
sections.body: The Builder owns the repeatable static output shape.

actionsDescription: Copy a prompt that should route to the static artifact lane.

actions.label: Build static report
actions.intent: Ask an agent to build a report that can be opened directly.
actions.cadence_hint: Use when no runtime server state is required.
actions.prompt: Use jun-ui to build a file-openable dashboard artifact from the current project data. Keep the final result openable through file:// and run verify-page --strict.

postActionSections.title: Acceptance
postActionSections.body: The final output is complete only after strict static verification passes.
items: Confirm the page is nonblank and styled.
Confirm the action button and prompt field work.
